correctness.rationale: For z away from the internal eigenvalues, the hub Schur complement subtracts (2z+2t_j cos φ_j)/(z²−t_j²) for each petal. Clearing denominators proves the determinant identity everywhere; the guaranteed multiplicities divide even when extra roots are present. After grouping equal t_j, evaluation at the distinct positive τ_r leaves only its corresponding class term with coefficient −2τ_r times the nonzero product of the squared-weight differences. This verifies the full cospectral equivalence, including class extrema, not only generic phases. Labelled cubic diagonal entries have exactly two closed walks, with conjugate phases, so they recover cos φ_j but not its sign. In the equal-weight example P=z(z²−1)(z²−5) for both assignments and the cubic difference is 6/5. Splitting the weights gives distinct polynomials. An independently built exact example at weights (1,1,3,4) with nontrivial complex phases checked polynomial division/evaluation and the cubic diagonals; replay with `OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python /tmp/opencode/frozen-review-diagnostics.py` (check 2). The frozen exact and numerical scripts were inspected, not executed. Finite algebra checks supplement the all-size argument.
residual_risks: This is exact-data recovery at known bond strengths. No numerical stability near coalescing strengths, oriented sign recovery or inversion with unknown strengths follows. evidence: By weighted Sachs, subtracting P for two phase assignments with the same strengths cancels every matching term, leaving −2Σ_j t_j Δcos φ_j Π_{k≠j}(z²−t_k²). Divide by the fixed product of all repeated factors (z²−τ_r²)^(n_r−1). Evaluating at τ_r now gives −2τ_r ΔC_r times Π_{s≠r}(τ_r²−τ_s²), which is nonzero unless ΔC_r=0. This is the claimed necessity and sufficiency and the same explicit inverse (the phase-independent polynomial is known and may be subtracted).

For a peripheral site a_j, only its own triangle is removed upon deletion. The top third coefficient in the weighted Sachs formula is −2 times the sum of real triangle products. Comparing that coefficient before/after deletion yields 2t_j cos φ_j as the removed positive contribution; equivalently tr H³−tr H_{\hat a_j}³=3(H³)_{a_j,a_j} because every nonzero closed walk at order three is a triangle. This recovers the local formula mechanically.

value.rationale: Knowing which flux observables a spectrum can recover is a motivated problem, and the worked example illustrates it clearly. In this exact family, however, the proposed invariant and local fix reduce to the ordinary weighted cycle coefficient and evaluation at its known distinct poles. There is no further demonstrated non-routine result on, for example, unknown weights, near-coincident strengths or measurement sufficiency under noise. The correct specialization is useful exposition, but not an independently needed new mathematical result under the value standard.
residual_risks: This is not a judgment against magnetic inverse spectroscopy as a research problem; it concerns only the exact observables and graph restrictions in the frozen finding.
